findings.title: Call to undefined zero-arg method breaks compilation
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only definition in parent UsernamePasswordForm is protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user). There is no zero-arg overload, so the code does not compile and the project cannot build. The call should pass the current user, e.g. isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()).

findings.title: Conditional passkeys never initialized for anonymous first login
findings.body: New helper isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) returns webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null. It is used in authenticate and in challenge(error,field) to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm. When no user is selected yet (initial login, context.getUser()==null) it is always false, so no WebAuthn challenge or ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI attribute is set. Previously the code filled the form when the user was null. Tests still expect //form[@id='webauth'] on the initial page, so initial conditional-UI passkey login is broken while re-authentication is fixed.
